column3: FLORINIA: This facility's digital security system appears substandard.
A brute force attack should be sufficient. Please hold.
JULIA: Brute force? I don't think we're gonna punch through the door!
\PN, think you can find where they keep the explosives? It wasn't the way we came, but it's probably nearby!
If you can do that, we'll be in easily!
FLORINIA: Why is combustion your solution to any obstacle?
JULIA: Fun for the whole family?
FLORINIA: Indeed.
FERN: Whatever, man, I don't have time to sit around all day and wait for the Flobot to hack into the system. Let's just go find some bombs already.
JULIA: That's the spirit! For once Fern says something I agree with!
Quick, \PN! To the boom-mobile!
JULIA: They were planning on kabooming my Gym, so they must have explosives here somewhere.  Let's find them!
FERN: Here you go, crazy lady.
JULIA: Boomies! You got them!
Okay, let's do this!
JULIA: Okay! Three... Two... Ka...
...Huh?
FLORINIA: Access granted. Let us proceed.
JULIA: Wait, but...
I-- And...
The booms!
What about the booms?!
Rini! You can't do that!
I was just about to-- Rini!!!
FERN: Hah, leave it to my sister to ruin everyone's fun.
Whatever, let's just get a move on it.
It does take time to encode the necessary anti-security program.
One moment, please.
Ugh...
JULIA: You!  Are you the one in charge here?
???: And if I am?
JULIA: We're gonna blow your face off for what you did to Grandview Station!
???: Amusing. Tell me, what power do you think you have to do so?
JULIA: Just who do you think you are, anyway?!
???: You know already. We are Team Meteor. And we do not relent.
Don't think you got through this place on your own ability.
We had no intention of defeating you.
Our purpose here is forfeit already.
But it was necessary to let you in, so that you could attend a demonstration.
JULIA: Let us in?
???: Did you really think you hacked our security so easily? Foolish.
I ordered our operators to slow you down long enough to delete all mission critical data from our systems.
But it seems we overestimated your strength. Time was ample.
We grew tired of waiting.
Now, enough talk.
Aster.
ASTER: Yes, boss!
???: Eclipse.
ECLIPSE: Yeah?
???: Deal with the small fries.
I can handle the Gym Leaders.
ECLIPSE: Hmph. If you say so.
ASTER: For Team Meteor!
...Huh?
ASTER: Grr!
???: So you lost already? How disappointing.
I can take on two myself easily, but four...
Well, it was an amusing diversion.
Don't think you've won, though.
Team Meteor does not forgive.
JULIA: Is he gone?
FLORINIA: Affirmative. Cradily, return.
JULIA: You too, Electrode! Good job~
Now let's see...
Mhm, mhm~
Okay! You all should start running now!
FERN: Huh? What did you do, now?
JULIA: Kaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa...
FERN: Oh, shit! Let's move!
Voltorb approaches the metal gate and begins to glow...
VOLTORB: Bzzt!
Voltorb seems to want to follow you. It's burning with energy.
Where has Julia gone now?
Challengers and work alike have been stacking up for her ever since she left.
I swear, someone so irresponsible shouldn't be put in charge of a place like this,
Let alone have taken on so much work in the city reconstruction.
Or maybe I should just say "deconstruction", considering Julia was placed in charge of the demolition of old buildings.
I swear, that woman doesn't know the meaning of the word "safety".
Careful, or everything will blow up in your face!
Kaboom!
You're dynamite!
It's absurd how she allows civilians into the power plant.
I suppose it's the price we pay for saving city space by turning the plant into a Gym.
This place is still absurd.
Looking for a Badge? You'll have to get through me first.
All right. Go win your shit.
What are you waitin' around here for?
Everyone here is so reckless. You know, there are switches to the gates behind the gym.
Then again, those switches were covered up by Julia herself.
I do wish they would stop making us repair the doors.
AME: \PN?
Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
Anyway...
AME: This is your first Gym Battle in Reborn, right?
Reborn's Gym Leaders are a little tougher than other regions'. For instance, every leader has a full team of six Pokémon!
Not only that, but they also use special arenas, or Fields, for tactical advantages.
If you want to survive in Reborn, you should get used to learning about and playing in these Fields!
You may even find ways to turn some opponents' arenas against them!
As for Julia, her Electric Field will make all of her same-type attacks even stronger, and add a jolt to some other attacks like her explosions!
It's standard fare, but if you have something that can tank Electric attacks, you're almost home free.
Failing that, your best bet is to come in with a full team, and hopefully some high-HP Pokémon to take the hits while you whittle her down.
Also, in case you end up needing a little more training, there should be some trainers here at the Grand Hall who would fight you freely!
Good luck!
No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
Welcome to Neo-Circuit Bowling, how may I make your day explode with happiness.
...Sigh, I need a new job.
JULIA: Okay-- okay,
Keep your eyes closed, a little further, and...
JULIA: Open!
JULIA: We finally got the go-ahead from the Grand Hall, and BOOM!
All the machinery's been moved safely downstairs, and they allowed us to rebuild the main area into--
You guessed it-- a bowling alley!!!
FLORINIA: I was quite surprised when she told me.
I would not have taken her for a bowler.
JULIA: That's the thing-- I'm not!!!
I've never bowled once in my entire life!
But now!
I can!
Ooh, and-- and!!!
JULIA: The bowling balls--
If you get a strike, they explode in the end zone!
If you get a GUTTER BALL,
They explode when they come back!
ARCHER: ...Is that truly safe?
MAXWELL: ...Is that really okay?
JULIA: Who knows!
Besides, it was your idea, in a way!
You're the one who said I should try to get more enjoyment out of the gym!
ARCHER: ...I suppose I am nothing if not an entrepeneur.
You thought I might be doing something like that on that train, right?
MAXWELL: Heh. Well, if nothing else, it'll be one hell of a spectacle.
FLORINIA: If I may belay your concerns,
During construction, I took the liberties of arranging a few accommodations for safety.
The Voltorb have been trained to perform a small Aftermath on gutter balls only.
A token explosion: exciting, but not harmful.
As for the end-zone,
5.4 inch thick reinforced blast-proof titanium for the walls...
Similar durability on the machine casing...
Uniquely-furnished resistant polish on the wood lanes...
Even the paint is specially-ordered to not so much as chip or brown in the face of combustive force.
It may require a cleaning here or there, but we are built to last.
JULIA: Just like us!
FLORINIA: Us?
JULIA: Our friendship!
FLORINIA: Our friendship is reinforced with 5.4 inch thick titanium?
JULIA: YES!
We've gotta have at least that much to keep on lettin' the good times bowl!
ARCHER: ...
MAXWELL: ...
JULIA: Now who's up for a game?!
We'll handle the situation. Stay back if you have no immediate business in the ward.
No other bombs have been found. Please remain calm.
Nothing to see here; move along.
I don't know, but judging by the landing of the rubble, it seems most likely that the bomb was placed underneath the Stairway.
Underneath? I always assumed it was totally solid.
They opened! The Grand Gates, sealed for years, have finally opened!
Wondering what this marvel is? Kids these days, don't know a thing.
These here are the Grand Gates to Reborn City! They used to be the main passage between the city and the Aventurine Region!
But massive as they are, they haven't opened in years.
Closed.
Open from 8PM to 4AM

Are you as heartbroken as your Pokémon is when it has to be traded away from you just to grow?

FERN: Man, these bitch-ass cops won't even let us through.
Yeah, there was a terrorist threat. I get it.
But they should be accepting help from the people to deal with it.
If they could do it on their own, this wouldn't have happened in the first place.
They're too tripped up on their own power and policies to even see that.
That right there is why the bad guys keep getting away--
Because no one on our side has the backbone to stop them.
I guess they're not ready for people of my caliber.
There's another gym in the Lapis Ward, so I'm gonna get ready to bust it in.
Later, loser.
Introducing!
Presenting!
This is pretty cool...
CAIN: There you are!
As soon as I distract this guy, make a break for it!
I don't know how long I'll be able to keep his attention.
You ready?
CAIN: Right on.
CAIN: Man, he's not even that cute.
Well, whatever. Maybe it'll make this work better.
CAIN: Hello, excuse me?
OFFICER: Not right now, son, we're busy.
CAIN: I-- I'm sorry, but I need to report a crime.
OFFICER: What-- with all this happening?
What kinda crime is it?
CAIN: I, uh...
I was struck.
OFFICER: Who did this to you? When?
CAIN: ...Should I really say here?
Someone might be watching...
OFFICER: ...Well, I can't leave this post.
Here, step aside with me.
OFFICER: Why don't you tell me exactly what happened, son?
CAIN: Well, like I said, I was struck...
...By your stunning good looks~
OFFICER: I... beg your pardon?
CAIN: Okay, gotta make sure we're set.
I'll wait until you finally say 'yes' to me~
Oh! I think I'll get one of these for my Kadabra!
Technology these days...
CAIN: Sorry, sorry!
It was just a joke, haha~
The truth is, I'm a bit lost.
OFFICER: Lost? You ain't from around here?
CAIN: Oh, no, I grew up not too far outside the city.
But I couldn't help but be lost in your eyes~
OFFICER: Son, if you don't have a real crime to report, I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.
CAIN: Okay, sorry-- I've been dancing around it because I'm nervous.
The truth is,
It's a crime how attractive you are~
OFFICER: Son.
OFFICER: I'm gonna have to ask you to head on home.
CAIN: Oh, that's okay.
Because I can't help but feel that my home is in your arms~
OFFICER: What exactly are you trying to do here?
CAIN: What I'm trying to do?
You~
Isn't that obvious?
OFFICER: I'm gonna have to write you up.
CAIN: Oooh, breaking out the handcuffs, are we?
OFFICER: Son, you know I can classify this as sexual harrassment, right?
CAIN: Okay, okay!
Joke's over; I don't wanna make you feel uncomfortable for real, sir.
Truth is, my friend put me up to this as a dare.
OFFICER: Uh huh.
I'm gonna need you to stick around while I take down your information.
OFFICER: Cain LaRue...
And what's your home address?
I don't have one.
No joke, officer.
OFFICER: ...Oh boy, this is gonna be complicated.
Link Stone? Sounds silly!
VICTORIA: Battle me.
VICTORIA: And here we are again.
When I face this way, and look out over the lake,
I can see the academy from here.
That's my home.
It's like nothing's changed.
And then just behind me, a bomb site.
Surreal.
And what have I done?
I teamed up with you to stop Team Meteor before and was immediately captured like some useless damsel.
I don't accept that.
\PN, you have my heartfelt gratitude for giving me a chance to break free.
Battle me.
I need to learn and grow much stronger if I'm ever going to make a real difference here.
Are you up for it?
VICTORIA: Great!
In full force and fury, I'll show you the fervor of the Apophyll Academy fighting style!
VICTORIA: I can't say I'm not a little disappointed that I don't measure up better,
But then I haven't exactly been training in ideal circumstances lately.
Thanks for taking the time for--
FERN: Yaaaaaaawwwwwnnnn~
FERN: That was one lame display on both your parts.
VICTORIA: Really.
FERN: Pretty sure I coulda done better in my sleep!
VICTORIA: ...I don't believe we've met.
FERN: That's your loss.
Name's Fern.
Cool cat, top dog-- you know how it is.
You may be easy in battle, but you're easier on the eyes.
VICTORIA: Excuse me?
FERN: Oh come on, smile!
It's a compliment, lady.
What do you say we hang out sometime?
Just you and me.
VICTORIA: Yeah, I don't think so.
FERN: Your loss!
Can't imagine you get too much attention over that giant forehead of yours.
VICTORIA: If you keep talking, you're gonna regret it.
FERN: Oh, I'm SO scared of some bitch who just got swept by a scrub like \PN.
VICTORIA: \PN, you know this guy?
FERN: He's kinda been my wingman once or twice, but that's it.
FERN: She's kinda been my wingman once or twice, but that's it.
FERN: They've kinda been my wingman once or twice, but that's it.

Just got my third badge, like taking candy from a baby.
That twerp leader was crying like one by the end of it too.
What an embarrassment.
If even people like Shelly can be Gym Leaders, no wonder the Flobot got in.
Anyway, \PN, what do you say we have a rematch?
I think we're past due, and this girl isn't worth my time.
VICTORIA: Didn't you just ask me out like thirty seconds ago?
FERN: Out of pity.
VICTORIA: ...

Better \PN fights you before I do something you'll really regret.
Here, let me heal your team first.

VICTORIA: Hah!

Paltry tricks and pot-shots are only gonna get you so far in the League.
